column1: # Commit map for the 2026-11-15 history rewrite.
# The compaction re-read notice archive (b59b12e16c) recorded estimated run
# costs in transcripts and quorum logs. In every blob the 13 unpushed commits
# from b59b12e16c to dab6fb1643 added or modified, numeric cost fields were set
# to null and the cost column of quorum's summary lines was dropped. 13 commit
# ids changed; the tip tree is unchanged. 54bf447b9b, which had nulled the
# figures, is kept as an empty commit with its message. Commits before
# b59b12e16c keep their ids and signatures.
